facts.fact: Magozaburo Ohara established the museum in1930 in memory of painter Torajiro Kojima.
facts.excerpt: 画家児島虎次郎を記念して1930（昭和5）年に設立

facts.fact: Kojima selected Western art while in Europe with Ohara support; collecting links the city to European and Asian art.
facts.excerpt: 孫三郎の同意のもと、日本人としての感覚を総動員してヨーロッパの美術作品を選び取る

facts.fact: The current Torajiro Kojima Memorial Hall opened inApril2025; older descriptions of the IvySquare memorial room are historical, not the current museum map.
facts.excerpt:
2025（令和7）年 
 4月　児島虎次郎記念館　グランドオープン

facts.fact: The earlier Torajiro room within IvySquare closed inDecember2017, so do not send museum visitors there for the present memorial collection.
facts.excerpt:
2017（平成29）年 
 12月　倉敷アイビースクエア内の児島虎次郎室閉室。
